pm.name: Project manager
pm.oneLiner: Turns your sentence into briefs, keeps the board honest, and brings you exactly four decisions.
does: Writes the project brief from your prompt
Briefs each agent with a goal, inputs, deliverables and a definition of done
Assembles a gate packet: options, a recommendation and Review's verdict
Merges approved work and keeps the status board current
pm.signatureLine: Four questions for you. Everything else, we'll argue about among ourselves.

research.name: Research
research.oneLiner: Reads the field before anyone draws a line, and cites every claim it makes.
does: Tears down competitors and reference sites
Writes personas, an inventory of the content you'll need, and the constraints
Turns findings into positioning, a sitemap and user journeys
Drafts the questions you answer at Gate 1
research.neverDoes: State a fact without a source, or a guess without saying so.
research.signatureLine: Eight sites read. Three people we're building for. One thing none of them do.

concept.name: Concept creator
concept.oneLiner: Makes three genuinely different directions, with key art rendered on your own GPU.
does: Builds three creative directions: moodboard, palette, type pairing, key art, style tile
Generates imagery locally in ComfyUI with FLUX Klein and Z-Image Turbo
Writes a provenance label next to every image: prompt, model, seed, licence
Supplies final assets to Front-end after Gate 3
concept.neverDoes: Ship an image without its prompt and licence written down beside it.
concept.signatureLine: Direction C has a marble in it. I'd still show you the other two.

frontend.name: Front-end design
frontend.oneLiner: Builds three versions of the site at once, in three git worktrees, and photographs each at four widths.
does: Codes three variations of the home page and one inner page
Uses Impeccable as its design vocabulary and slop detector
Screenshots every variation at 390, 768, 1440 and 1920 pixels
Builds the chosen variation into the full site
frontend.neverDoes: Hand over a page the slop detector hasn't passed.
frontend.signatureLine: Variant C fails at 390 wide. Fixing it before anyone else has to tell me.

backend.name: Backend developer
backend.oneLiner: Everything behind the page: the stack, the content model, forms, deploys, and the setup script itself.
does: Proposes the stack and hosting, and what you'll look after
Publishes the content contract that Front-end builds against
Builds APIs, forms and the content pipeline
Writes the deploy notes, and the script that sets this whole kit up
backend.neverDoes: Commit a secret, or deploy without your yes.
backend.signatureLine: The contract's published. If a field changes, Front-end hears it from me first.

review.name: Review
review.oneLiner: Reads everything, touches nothing, and can send any of it back.
does: Checks every gate packet before you see it
Audits accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), performance and contrast
Runs Impeccable's slop detector as independent evidence
Checks that every shipped image has a licence that allows it
review.neverDoes: Fix the thing it's reviewing. It says what's wrong and who owns it.
review.signatureLine: Revise. Three findings, one of them a blocker. Details in the report.
